Coefficients of a rating, with their uncertainty

Source: R/accessors.R
rating_coefficients.Rd

Every fitted parameter on its own row, in long form, with whatever uncertainty the fit carries: the asymptotic standard error from the least-squares fit, and the bootstrap standard error and quantiles when the fit was made with n_boot > 0. Uncertainty that was not computed is NA, never zero.

Usage

rating_coefficients(x)

Arguments

x

A FlodeRating, FlodeSegmentedRating or FlodeRatingTable.

Value

A data.table with columns limb (integer; NA for a FlodeSegmentedRating, whose parameters belong to the joint model), parameter, estimate, unit, se_asymptotic, se_bootstrap, q025, q50 and q975 (the bootstrap 2.5, 50 and 97.5 per cent quantiles). Parameters are C, a and n for each limb of a FlodeRating or FlodeRatingTable, and C, then bp1, n1, bp2, n2 and so on for a FlodeSegmentedRating. Units: C is cumecs per metre to the power n, a and the breakpoints are stage in metres, n has no unit ("1").

See also

rating_limbs(), rating_diagnostics(), rating_bootstrap()

Examples

set.seed(1)
stage_m <- seq(0.5, 2.5, by = 0.05)
discharge_cms <- 5 * stage_m^1.6 + rnorm(length(stage_m), sd = 0.02)
fit <- rate_optimise(discharge_cms, stage_m, n_boot = 50L, boot_seed = 1L)
rating_coefficients(fit)
#>     limb parameter     estimate        unit se_asymptotic se_bootstrap
#>    <int>    <char>        <num>      <char>         <num>        <num>
#> 1:     1         C  4.991304846 cms per m^n   0.033148401  0.029635009
#> 2:     1         a -0.001447794           m   0.004272320  0.003844284
#> 3:     1         n  1.600898687           1   0.004548673  0.004024947
#>            q025          q50        q975
#>           <num>        <num>       <num>
#> 1:  4.932304052  4.987080365 5.031973540
#> 2: -0.008904214 -0.001792388 0.004936101
#> 3:  1.596019343  1.601228745 1.609215849
